title: Cross-mission canonical artifact input binding — governed consume of ACCEPTED artifacts from sibling missions
description: Fixes FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT for bound missions consuming artifacts ACCEPTED by earlier sibling missions. New seam: ArtifactDependencyResolver.listEligibleExternalInputSources(mission) — ACCEPTED+re-verified artifacts from missions sharing the consumer's Objective lineage (WOB->work item->WAL->objective->siblings; none/cross-objective/own = empty, CAP-bound). bindPlanExternalInputs stamps reserved pair_dataflow_sources (contract pair-external-artifact-input.v1) pinning consume_name + immutable source identity: one match binds, zero stays UNBOUND, >1 AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE; planner stamps stripped; drift/conflict SOURCE_BINDING. requiredEdges exempts only source-bound consumes (in-plan rule unchanged); assert seams prove stamp shape + CURRENT eligibility. Reconcile/runPlanning/replan thread input_artifact_sources; resolveForConsumer re-proves eligibility NOW -> canonical DependencyArtifactEntry pins; materializeForConsumer derives expected producer mission from durable execution row. 17 focused tests: positive bind, replay, byte-exact materialization, adversarial (absent/ambiguous/no-lineage/cross-objective/forged/tampered/corrupt-CAS/revoked/out-of-scope), in-plan + same-mission rules preserved. Regression: f2 53 + dataflow-incident 125 + f1 20 + f2-r1 43 + delivery suites pass; baseline flake f4 R5.1-crash fails identically on BASE 1f6d4af.
